sourceNotes: Issue #263: first MPFB2 humanoid promoted into a station cast (OB triage patient Aisha Khan).

Issue #222: MPFB rail paints the proven bounds-derived scalp hair region (Anny automate_blender apply_mesh_native_scalp_hair_material_region) instead of the hand-authored UV sphere; no separate hair mesh remains. Textures remain out of scope by peer decision.

Issue #317: face targets now load through the proven TargetService path (body_param_stage.load_mpfb_face_shape_keys) instead of the MPFB UI operator, which read panel state and shipped zero face morphs. The #222 scalp-region Z-flip was also corrected: create_human faces -Y (measured), so the flip pushed the face to +Y, the face-band exclusion never fired, and the scalp paint covered the eyes/brows.

Issue #318: the candidate materializer strips MakeHuman's clothes and hair FITTING SHELLS with the MPFB-shipped ExportService.bake_modifiers_remove_helpers (remove_helpers=True), called after the face-target load so morph keys stay indexed to the full base topology. The shipped GLB drops from 36,972 to 26,756 tris (13,380 verts in Blender, MADR 0052 documented pair); the 32 FACS targets and 137-joint rig survive. The post-strip figure is an unclothed body; OB triage wardrobe staging is MADR 0052 P3.

Issue #321: the candidate materializer fits the CC0 toigo_basic_tucked_t-shirt onto the stripped basemesh via the PROVEN ClothesService.fit_clothes_to_human path (body_param_stage.py uses the same service for the hm08 library rail). The fit runs after the strip because .mhclo vertex refs index the 13,380-vert hm08 topology; the polo (helper-vert refs) is refused rather than fitted against absent indices. Garment material mat_makeclothes_library_toigo_t_shirt; garment 2,700 tris / 5,400 exported verts, skinned to the standard rig. Total 29,456 tris; 13 usable mouth targets and 137 joints unchanged. Garment choice is the least-wrong OB triage option: a hospital gown is not in the cached library and a scrub shirt is staff wear.

Issue #323: body-part hiding wired from the sibling rail (D1 — apply_body_hide_material_region, body_param_stage.py:651, mask from garment_coverage.body_hide_mask, scoped away from the hands). The rail had no body-part hiding, so the fitted t-shirt and the body both rendered and the body poked through the cloth. The hidden faces carry an alpha-0 material that exports as alphaMode=MASK / alphaCutoff=0.5 and are DISCARDED at render; geometry, rig, shape keys and garment placement are untouched. Exported GLB: hidden primitive openclinxr_hidden_upper_mpfb_ob_patient_aisha_body_mesh (1,605 verts / 2,636 tris; 10.5% of the body vs the library rail's known-good 10.1%; 0 hidden hand verts), AABB inside the garment footprint. See the issue close for the pixel grade.
Not a realism gate pass; orchestrator grades the render and decides whether the material-class mismatch blocks adoption.

The generated bytes therefore differ from the tracked candidates/ comparator (which predates #321's garment fit); outputSha256 below reflects this bake. Issue #341: re-baked with corrected body-hide mask semantics on the shipped bytes. (a) Poke force-hide: the #326 footprint clip tested all three AABB axes INCLUDING depth, so it un-hid genuine pokes (a poke protrudes past the garment front depth); the materializer now re-hides region faces with min vertex clearance < 0 inside the garment x/z silhouette + 2mm contract slack (1,469 pokes re-hidden; visible torso pokes 428 -> 162, interior breast/sternum/midriff pokes to 0). (b) Black-sliver un-hide: hidden faces that neither poke the garment nor have the garment between them and the front viewer are un-hidden (35) so the dark body interior does not show through. (c) x/z re-clip after the force-hide keeps the hidden AABB inside the garment bounds + 2mm on the silhouette axes (47 polygons). (d) Foot-band fix: the foot hide band now stops at the shoe top (0.056) instead of the ankle landmark (0.10), so the upper foot/ankle above the flat is no longer discarded (the flattened-disc hole). Occlusion gate post-fix: eyes 0.843 visible, tshirt 0.003 occluded-by-other, boots 0.004. mpfb2-lower-garment-and-mask-footprint (2) remains PRE-EXISTING red on the #333/#338 foot mask (axis1 min 94.4mm, axis2 max 30.9mm) — identical on the pre-change bytes; this bake adds zero violations. Issue #341 round 5 (2026-08-12): the forehead rectangle is fixed. The scalp crown band painted the face front above the eye socket to the crown (scalp maxZ 0.153 was 1.4 cm ANTERIOR of the eyes' 0.139). The shared scalp function's face-front exclusion never fires on MPFB bodies because its depth line is whole-body (hanging-arm-dominated; skippedFaceFrontFaceCount: 0 every bake), and no hairline reference exists in the shipped anatomy (measured: no hairline vertex group — all head joint groups are helper verts >= 13380, stripped; no MakeHuman hairline target; forehead targets run to the crown). The materializer now derives the hairline per-body from the body's own surface: forehead plane = median depth (y) of the head's midline surface within the fitted EYE MESH's own height band; hairline = highest face-front vertex at/ahead of that plane (aisha 0.9715 H). Midline half-width = the eye mesh's own half-width. 60 scalp polys unpainted in the face front below the hairline. Post-fix scalp maxZ 0.1316 < eye maxZ 0.1392 (scalp now BEHIND the eyes); occlusion gate: eyes 0.833 visible with NO scalp occluder (was scalp 0.213-0.5), tshirt 0.0027, boots 0.0016 occluded-by-other. Waistband sawtooth and toe-through-shoe remain queued; the pixel grade is the orchestrator's.

Issue #341 rounds 5b/5c (2026-08-12): (5b) waistband band [shirt hem 0.969, pants top 0.987] region-hide in the lower mask (68 faces) — the poke-masks left the belly coincident with the shirt surface exposed; post-fix 0/54 unhidden torso waistband samples visible (was 21.8%). (5c) shoe lateral alignment: each shoe half's x-centre aligned to the body's own foot-band x-centre (deltaX +-0.0425 m) because the fitted shoe sat ~3.4 cm medial of the foot (foot x [-0.270,-0.174] vs shoe [-0.236,-0.138], same width) — the foot's lateral edge rendered outside the shoe ('toes protrude through both shoe fronts'). Foot-hide coverage 2048 -> 3900 faces. Occlusion gate: eyes 0.769 visible, tshirt 0.0028, boots 0.0000 occluded-by-other; all three verdicts visible. Residual: upper ankle skin above the 5.6cm flat is normal anatomy; shoulder/elbow slivers remain a pixel question.

Issue #351 (2026-08-12): re-baked with the wrist/metacarpal limb vocabulary fix in body_param_stage._LIMB_BONE_RE. The lower cover shell's band selection wrapped the A-pose hands on the peds bodies (their palms are metacarpal-dominant; the regex missed the MPFB standard rig's wrist/metacarpal bones) — trouser shards on the hands. This body has no wrist/metacarpal-dominant verts in the trouser band (all finger-dominant, already excluded), so the widened regex is a no-op here; every contract quantity is unchanged (lateral ratio 1.218, leg area 5207 cm2, overlap 19.6 mm).
